notes.title: Update 2.1
notes.content:
- Cloud Save Games (Steam Cloud)
- Graphics settings and other settings now also possible at the game info screen
- Goals are celebrated with hockey sounds
- The "continuous week" can be canceled before each game
- Display of ticket income at home games
- Changing the season ticket price also in the hall overview
- Season tickets and admission prices can be changed at the beginning of the season also with a home games
- Better transfers
- FinanceGameDesign.csv config-file can be edited
- Better selection of a new mail when deleting an old mail
- Sponsorship contract offers are recalculated every season
- When the club is founded, players now become professionals or amateurs depending on the league
- Derby opponents will be recalculated when the club is founded
- Better handling of  low amounts within automatic and manual sponsor negotiations
- Fixed a bug at the Allstar game
- Incorrect selection and marking in the drop-down box for cup statistics
- Fixed a bug with the Achievement "Coach of the Year"
- Small bug when saving in the sponsors-menue fixed
- Cups with fixed, constant amount of teams is possible
- Fixed a crash with large number of players (more than 50) in the lineup
- Player negotiations improvements
